family: Blame File Open and Recent linked-worktree metadata authority
implementation: Scoped File Open/Recent identifies the authorized repository marker and obtains required Git directory/common directory/object alternate grants before launching Git discovery.
Dependency discovery is capped at 64 added grants, uses only live security scopes and preserves the primary working-folder containment boundary.
An exact owned directory-only single-selection panel starts at the required folder with hidden files visible; wrong, duplicate, cancelled and retired replies cannot adopt or persist a document.
Preparation counters and controller completion retain ownership through real sheet detachment and worker drain, including initial file/root choices and queued preparation admission.
Optional auxiliary bookmarks preserve backward decoding of old archives; strict restoration is the default and only the scoped repair-capable controller can skip unavailable extras before preflight.
All bookmark creation and validation precede atomic publication, bounded to four records, 64 extras per record, 1 MiB per bookmark and 8 MiB encoded archive.
Successful readable HEAD publication renews the complete primary/auxiliary receipt with the same recent ID; filesystem/provider failures retain existing archive bytes and rows.
planned_cases: Real linked worktree plus external alternates; exact metadata dependencies and no Git invocation before all grants
Full composite archive restoration with no prompt, stale bookmark renewal and older primary-only repair
Atomic auxiliary bookmark creation failure and strict inactive/unavailable restoration refusal
Actual hidden initial file/root sheets with deliberately early replies: no next panel or Git until both sheet and parent detach; continuous Close/Quit ownership
Forced Close before queued preparation begins: no metadata prompt or Git call, exact callback after ticket drainage
Wrong grant, actual hidden-sheet Cancel and forced Close with late replies; unchanged current document, MRU, refs, indexes and literal source bytes

validation.scope: Existing native-reference-batch blame-file-open with system and bundled Git; grouped Debug app build passed. No Core implementation changed and no Core suite was run.
validation.limits: Focused local checks do not establish full hosted CI, signed sandbox, physical Finder or complete visual parity.

limits: Private simulated bookmark grants do not establish actual signed sandbox acceptance.
No physical Finder/picker, moved external metadata store or complete Blame parity claim.
Primary and saved-extra bookmark resolution remains synchronous and bounded; no asynchronous store refactor is claimed.
